messages.author: edbcc711cdbb3da8
messages.subject: Re: Shiny app free version active for only 25 hours?
parts:
It is 25 active hours.  Not 25 hours.  Meaning 25 hours in which your application is up and responding to requests from end users.  What we have seen is that 99% of people who have an account on shinyapps.io won't hit the number.  

Hope this helps.
Tareef
